rationale: C23 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. The child expressly preserves rights acquired under the February 27, 1948 directive, identifying C23 by date, and both orders regulate federal reemployment or reinstatement rights through numbered personnel provisions, application deadlines or waiver rules, and Civil Service Commission rulemaking authority. The closely parallel Commission clause is concrete shared language, while the child adapts C23's continuing-rights machinery by exempting those newer rights from the general expiration imposed on older rights. C05 concerns the same personnel regime but is a narrow, individualized modification; C11 shares only generic expiration/effective-date machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This order shall not affect reemployment rights heretofore or hereafter acquired under ... No. 9932 of February 27, 1948.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Any such officer or employee who has, or acquires, a competitive status shall be entitled to the same rights with regard to reinstatement in such agency...
shared_material.explanation: The child expressly incorporates and preserves the category of reinstatement rights created by C23, adapting it as an exception to termination of older reemployment rights.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Civil Service Commission is authorized to prescribe such rules and regulations and to establish such procedures as may be necessary for the administration of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Civil Service Commission is authorized, after consultation with the Department of State, to prescribe such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this order
shared_material.explanation: This is close shared operative language assigning implementation of the personnel-rights scheme to the Civil Service Commission.

shared_material.child_excerpt: shall expire at the end of the six months' period ... unless application for reemployment ... shall have been made before the end of such six months' period
shared_material.parent_excerpt: shall be deemed to have waived his rights to reinstatement ... [if he] fails to avail himself of his right to reinstatement within thirty days after the end of his period of service
shared_material.explanation: Both use a defined post-service or post-order deadline, coupled with loss of reemployment or reinstatement rights, as the central administrative mechanism.
